protocol: DB: R2 val-chosen head designs (voice = DF-Arena fc5 MLP mlp_long alone, music = MERT 6+12 WindowMIL) trained on train subsets of the frozen R2 row universe (31,270 backbone rows); full val for early stopping, FILE refit and CDF tables; 2 seeds (41, 42) averaged; held-out test scored once after this lock; group bootstrap 1000 reps over test group_id with models fixed.

rules.exp1: Primary contrast = 50% rows: diversity is a limiter iff held-out ADS(Q50) - mean over 3 draws ADS(D50) > 0 with 95% group CI excluding 0; same test at 25%/75% reported as secondary. Quantity is a limiter at f iff ADS(full) - ADS(Qf) > 0 with CI excluding 0. Val numbers are the locked expectation; held-out can confirm or contradict them but nothing is re-selected on held-out.
rules.exp2: A family depends on its nearest train relatives iff error(LOFO) - error(CTRL) on the family error class (miss for fakes, FPR for reals, at each head's own held-out route-EER threshold) >= +0.05 absolute with the family-group bootstrap CI excluding 0. Relatives fixed in relatives.json before any held-out prediction was read.
rules.exp3: Held-out error concentrates on unseen generators iff miss(unseen) - miss(seen) > 0 with group CI excluding 0 (per component, 100% heads).
rules.pilot: R2 rule: +music_arena chosen iff val route ens EER improves by >= 0.002 AND the per-seed mean val EER improves; else base. Held-out reported regardless of the choice.
